column1: # Context: D_80085E48 is the camera (15150; 1FA00 writes its position at +0xC..0x14, angle at +0x2C); a map object (D_8007C290[], 0x18 bytes) has x/y/z, angle, scale, timer/model index at +0x14 and flags+kind at +0x16 (kind = low byte).

column3: makes the requested map D_800842C4 current (D_800842BC): DMAs its ROM block and extras (func_80028120), sets the area/sub-area tables (D_8007C284/88/8C/94, D_80084994), the backdrop textures, the player start point D_80084308, grounds map objects and inits their timers; called by 1870, 36E60 and 3B40 before the area starts
resets the per-frame spinner count D_8007C6AC and on map 0x1D rotates the 19 halfwords at D_80124E00 and bumps D_800842A8; called once per frame in all three 1870 loops just before the frame is built

collects the map objects of the grid cells around the camera into draw lists (MapObj_CollectCell) and draws the opaque/animated ones, spinners and billboards; also advances the sway phases, runs the clock palette blend (Map_BlendPaletteByClock) and the colour-table rotation func_80010768, and plays/stops the nearest ambient sound (Sfx_PlayIfAudible/Sfx_StopChannel4); called from the field draw sequence

second pass over the lists MapObj_UpdateAndDrawNearby filled: alpha-blended objects (env alpha D_80060C88[map]), objects of kind 0x40..0x45 with a scrolling texture (D_8004DDB4, scroll D_8004DDB0 += 2 per frame) and the kind 0x11/0x12 objects (func_80010104); called from the 1870 draw sequence

for each object id in a cell list: tracks the nearest ambient-sound object (flags 0x1000, sound id in bits 8..11), and by kind appends it to a draw list (opaque, 0x4000 second list, swaying kinds 1..3 offset by sins phases, billboard 0x10 also counted in D_8007C2A4, 0x11/0x12, 0x40..0x45, 0x7F/0x80) or runs it (0x81 func_8001A948, 0x82 spinner, 0x83/0x84 sprite emitters)

draws the area's model D_80060C48[D_80084994->unk1C].dl translated to the camera position (y - 10) with env colour D_80084B60..68, before the map objects, when the area flag D_8007C280 & 4 is set; neutral name for a model that follows the camera (renamed from Map_DrawBackdrop, a reading)
zeroes the timer of the 4 animated-object slots D_80084238; called by Map_LoadArea
returns 1 + the slot whose timer runs and whose id is the given map object, else 0; MapObj_UpdateAndDrawNearby uses it to offset/rotate objects with flags 0x100

takes a slot (the first free of 4) for a map object: state 1 runs the anim selected by type bits 8..11 (D_800579F8/D_80057F80/D_80058008) from the given frame to its end, state 0 waits 7 frames first; called by the player (3F50) when it uses such an object

per frame for each running slot: state 0 counts down then switches to state 1 for 80 frames; state 1 samples the slot's anim (func_80026A00) into its x offset and z rotation; called each frame from 1870

draws the kind 0x10 objects of one model type that are within 1500 units and inside the camera's view angle D_80085F50, each turned to the camera angle, with a ground shadow from the normal saved at load (D_80083638); called by MapObj_UpdateAndDrawNearby for types 0..3

kind 0x83: the timer counts up from a negative wait; at 0..7 spawns one sprite per frame (texture frame = timer, func Effect_AllocateSprite) moving up (vy 15) and along the object's angle, then waits a random 61..120 frames; the sprite's step is MapObj_StepArcSprite
sprite step callback of MapObj_EmitArcSprite's descriptor: moves by velocity, gravity 0.9 on vy, env alpha alternating with D_800842A8 & 1
kind 0x84: every random 150..300 frames spawns a sprite at the object (func_8001D9A8) whose step is func_8000FCE0
sprite step callback of MapObj_EmitDropSprite's descriptor: y += vy/2, vy -= 0.2 (falls from rest), env alpha from the sprite's alpha field * 5
zeroes both 8-entry spinner lists D_80083470/D_80083558 and the previous-frame count D_8007C6A8; called by Map_LoadArea

kind 0x82: appends the object (max 8 per frame) to this frame's spinner list (double-buffered on D_8007A17C), carrying its rotation phase over from last frame's entry for the same object or starting at a random multiple of 45 degrees
draws this frame's spinner list, each rotated by its phase (decreasing pi/200 per frame) on top of the object's angle; called by MapObj_UpdateAndDrawNearby

draws the objects of kind type (0x11 or 0x12) facing the camera angle, loading the CI texture frame tex[(timer >> 1) & 7] and an alpha from D_8004DE88[timer & 3], timer++ per frame; called by MapObj_DrawTranslucent

finds the D_8004DE98 entry for the game clock D_80084980 (12610 counts it per frame, wrapping); when the entry changes, fades the 256 RGBA5551 colours of D_800810B0 from the old to the new table in D_800814B0 over the entry's frame count, one step per call
